command: set +e; echo '=== ARCHITEKT FAILURE READONLY ==='; date -Is; hostname; echo '--- UNIT SHOW ---'; systemctl --user show frankenstein-architekt.service -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p ExecMainExitTimestamp -p FragmentPath -p ExecStart -p Environment 2>&1; echo '--- TIMER SHOW ---'; systemctl --user show frankenstein-architekt.timer -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p LastTriggerUSec -p NextElapseUSecRealtime -p FragmentPath 2>&1; echo '--- UNIT CAT ---'; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-architekt.service frankenstein-architekt.timer 2>&1; echo '--- JOURNAL ---'; journalctl --user -u frankenstein-architekt.service -n 120 --no-pager -o short-iso 2>&1; echo '--- PROCESSES ---'; ps -eo pid,lstart,cmd | grep -E '[f]rankenstein-architekt|[c]laude.*architekt|[a]rchitekt.*claude' || true; echo '=== END ==='; exit 0
